title: Build bounded Native KaTeX compositor conformance

sourceRefs.summary: Approved objective, coverage model, budgets, slice order, preservation boundary, rollback units, and checkpoint.

verificationRecords.notes: Validated 1,035 nodes and 23,683 events after cutover setup; complete v2 contract is active, malformed v1 is superseded, carrier run and action are deferred, and the return condition is explicit.
Approved proposal correction and generated control-plane records have no whitespace errors; protected economics and unrelated untracked files remain unstaged.
Three deterministic baseline assertions freeze canonical 2 as continuous, italic x as a symmetric 13.828125px source/material/target seam regression, and =4 as stationary.
Application, Node, test, Svelte, and domain TypeScript projects accept the test-only baseline fixture and command.
Inventory confirms the baseline command remains green and identifies the sole missing proof seam: browser-realized material ink correlated with existing native endpoint paint authority.
Six checks freeze baseline evidence plus hard canary/promotion/browser, five-sample, one-page, one-worker, zero-routine-screenshot, and zero-unseeded-fuzz budgets in 0.43 seconds.
Nine checks pass in 0.44 seconds; the test-only descriptor enforces shape/paint/ownership/baseline consistency, immutability, non-empty fixtures, and unique registry IDs.

Ten checks pass; structural risk tags are exhaustive, required by shape class, unique, immutable, and canonically ordered, with italic x represented as glyph plus font-style risk rather than a special-case shape.

Fourteen checks pass in 0.63 seconds; generic data-driven pairwise selection covers all five-factor pairs, includes the named three-way override, is deterministic, and fails closed when the scenario cap is insufficient.
Stable JSON-safe coverage manifest explains every selected scenario, its first-covered pairs, and any explicit three-way risk override; 16 tests pass.

expectedLearning: Determine whether feature-class coverage plus actual-paint seam observation can prevent Native KaTeX carrier discontinuities without glyph-specific branches or production cost.
allowedWork: Execute only the approved Native KaTeX compositor-conformance proposal through its typed run contract.
disallowedWork: Do not resume carrier promotion until conformance closes; do not ship test infrastructure or broaden into aesthetics, lessons, layouts, or other renderers.
